In this exuberant equestrian painting, Chand Bibi and three other noble court women are depicted mounted on galloping steeds playing polo on a wide, sloping green turf. The composition is charged with kinetic rhythm, showing horses of contrasting colors (white, chestnut, grey) converging dynamically.
